posts.body:
Sapphire City Part 3
We're back for another installment... get ready for more walking, talking and... walking! Although we are inching closer to being able to classify it as a narrative RPG game, we are still in the adventure/visual novel with RPG elements stage atm. Part 3 picks up right where we left off in Part 2. Some of your decisions will carry over to this game and cause deviations in the story. (Although you will have to confirm them in the story recap at the beginning of the game, haven't figured a way to carry them over... yet). A previously unseen part of the city opens up with new and returning characters, advanced game-play elements and like the other entries in the series, lots of pixel art! The game will have multiple endings and have more branching paths for the player to take through the game as well as some more spooky themes. Thanks to those that have played the series so far and hope you enjoy the next installment.

Story
Captured, alone and at the mercy of the Guilds, you are again without purpose. Yet hope remains, for reasons that still allude you, a second chance has been approved but at a terrible price. Will you continue to do the bidding of those in the shadows? In a yet unseen district of this great city, a new character enters the fray, she has risked much to help your cause, your actions will decide her fate, so choose your path carefully. As you go head to head with a titan of industry, the collateral damage begins to break the city apart. New and dangerous factions emerge seeking to capitalize on the chaos. The night is nearing its close, dawn is coming, but for now the city is still shrouded in darkness.
